verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents Tap to Pay, which turns a smartphone into a contactless checkout for cards and digital wallets, and POS Hub, which connects peripherals to a tablet over USB. Together these show its own in-person payment-acceptance hardware path, but nothing documents pairing a card reader with the app, registering a reader to an account, or how long setup takes. missing for 10: documented card-reader pairing/registration flow, evidence of time-to-first-payment within minutes, explicit card-reader support in the hardware lineup, independent or hands-on corroboration of setup.
